role: A checkpoint start's save directory (lane/divlib): CPDIR/save where it is a directory, else a refusal naming the path, and with CPDIR/save.tar.zst present saying the save is packed and how to unpack it (harvest.sh --unpack). Before it session.c took CPDIR/save on trust and a packed library's starts generated every chunk their checkpoint's save held.
notes: Called from session.c resolve_checkpoint at a session's open, never in the tick: only for a start whose tape header names a checkpoint (start.kind checkpoint). Seed and join snapshots never reach it. rl-play-gate's refusal cases (save missing, packed) pin it.
